segments.text: Ok so, this is the configurable page in the CopilotKit docs, for LangGraph TypeScript. There's no demo for this one, just the page itself, and uh, the part that matters is the TypeScript tab down here.
This tab only says to set the runtime context where your backend invokes the graph.
And the code is just this graph invoke. Umm, there's no frontend code at all, so you can't wire it up from a CopilotKit app.
